name: Mei Ling Tan
bio:
Mei Ling Tan has been immersed in the world of automotive aesthetics for over three decades. Her journey began in a small family-owned body shop in Singapore, where she honed her skills in color matching, surface preparation, and advanced painting techniques. A chance encounter with a racing team needing a specialist painter sparked her passion for motorsport. Since then, Mei Ling has dedicated herself to ensuring that every vehicle she works on is not just visually stunning but also aerodynamically optimized.

Her meticulous approach to paint application and her unwavering commitment to perfection have earned her a stellar reputation within the motorsport community. She understands that a flawless finish can significantly impact a car's performance, and she takes pride in delivering results that exceed expectations. Mei Ling's ability to blend technical expertise with artistic flair makes her an invaluable asset to any racing team.

Working at Vee Masters has provided her with new challenges. The variety in the team's liveries and the need for quick turnarounds keep her on her toes, but she wouldn't have it any other way. She is constantly looking for ways to improve the application process and reduce weight without sacrificing aesthetics.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly styled in a practical, short bob with subtle highlights.
physical.description: Mei Ling is a petite woman with a focused gaze and a warm smile that belies her meticulous nature.

quirks: Always wears a pair of lucky red gloves when applying the final clear coat.
Has a specific playlist of 80s synth-pop she listens to while working to maintain focus.
Insists on using only natural light when color-matching paint, regardless of the time of day.
